1. Eating too little — Your body needs enough food and energy to function properly. 2. Expecting overnight results — Healthy progress takes time, so be patient with yourself. 3. Ignoring your daily steps — Using a walking app can help you track your steps, stay motivated and work towards your daily movement goals! (I use Fastwalk) 4. Not drinking enough water — Keep a water bottle nearby and drink regularly throughout the day. 5. Doing workouts you hate — Find activities you genuinely enjoy so it’s easier to stay consistent. 6. Comparing your progress to others — Everyone’s body and journey are different, so focus on yourself. 7. Being too hard on yourself — Remember, consistency matters more than perfection. The best way to lose fat is to walk more… 👀 But there comes a point where less is MORE…  If you’re walking under 8-12k steps a day then you are missing out on the EASIEST way to help you lose body fat.  If you’re walking over 15k then you could be doing yourself a disservice. Recovery starts to take a hit & your hunger increases - taking you out of the deficit you were trying to be in.   Finding a sweet spot that works for your lifestyle and goals is key.  10k steps is what I prioritize and recommend.
